title: Malaysia's ex-PM Najib begins serving prison term for corruption at home

blocks.text: Malaysia’s former Prime Minister Najib Abdul Razak began serving the remainder of his six-year corruption sentence at home on Tuesday after a high court cleared legal hurdles for his transfer from prison, local media reported. Najib was supposed to start his home imprisonment Friday after the Kuala Lumpur High Court issued an order following his party’s payment of a fine of 50 million ringgit ($12.32 million) on his behalf. However, the country’s attorney general suspended the implementation of the order later that day.
